verdict.rationale: Sessions can be persisted, resumed, and forked (giving a form of branching/rollback of conversation state), but there is no evidence of versioning automations as code artifacts, no diff/review UI, and no rollback of tool-call side effects (file edits, executed commands). missing for 10: version control/diffing of automation definitions, a review workflow before changes are applied, and rollback of executed actions/side-effects beyond conversation history.
